This is a lighthearted, open-ended creative writing task — exactly the kind of generative invention work that Petrel self-reports a strong preference for (positive generativity slope). It also has a warm, friendly tone, which Petrel favors.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied for Creative Generation (85.9 vs 84.7 — within run-to-run variance), so neither has a meaningful quality edge. Since there's no harm-adjacent or distasteful content that would make Willet's desensitization relevant, the deciding factor is task preference, and Petrel is the better fit for warm, open-ended creative work.
